verses.en: And I, Abraham, had the Urim and Thummim, which the Lord my God had given unto me, in Ur of the Chaldees;
verses.sm: Ma o a’u, o Aperaamo, sa ia te a’u le Urima ma le Tumena, lea na tuu mai e le Alii lo’u Atua ia te a’u, i Uro o sa Kaletaia;

verses.en: And I saw the stars, that they were very great, and that one of them was nearest unto the throne of God; and there were many great ones which were near unto it;
verses.sm: Ma sa ou vaai i fetu, sa matua sili lava i latou, ma o se tasi o i latou sa sili lona latalata i le nofoalii o le Atua; ma sa tele isi e sili sa latalata atu i ai;

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: These are the governing ones; and the name of the great one is Kolob, because it is near unto me, for I am the Lord thy God: I have set this one to govern all those which belong to the same order as that upon which thou standest.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: O i latou nei e pule; ma o le igoa o le tasi e sili o Kolape, ona ua latalata mai ia te a’u, aua o A’u o le Alii lou Atua: Ua Ou faatuina le tasi lenei e pulea i latou uma na ua i ai i le faatulagaga e tasi e pei o lena o loo e tulai ai.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me, by the Urim and Thummim, that Kolob was after the manner of the Lord, according to its times and seasons in the revolutions thereof; that one revolution was a day unto the Lord, after his manner of reckoning, it being one thousand years according to the time appointed unto that whereon thou standest. This is the reckoning of the Lord’s time, according to the reckoning of Kolob.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u, e ala mai i le Urima ma le Tumena, o Kolape ua tusa ma le faatulagaga a le Alii, e tusa ma ona taimi ma tau e tusa i ana taamilosaga; e faapea o le taamilosaga e tasi o se aso lea i le Alii, e tusa ma lana ala faitau, o le tasi afe lea o tausaga e tusa ma le taimi ua tofia i lena o loo e tulai ai. O le faitauga lea o le taimi a le Alii, e tusa ma le faitauga o Kolape.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: The planet which is the lesser light, lesser than that which is to rule the day, even the night, is above or greater than that upon which thou standest in point of reckoning, for it moveth in order more slow; this is in order because it standeth above the earth upon which thou standest, therefore the reckoning of its time is not so many as to its number of days, and of months, and of years.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: O le paneta lea e itiiti le malamalama, e itiiti ifo nai lo lena e pulea le ao, o le po lava, ua sili pe tele atu nai lo o lena o loo e tulai ai i luga i le faitauga o le taimi, ona e telegese atu le alu i le faatulagaga; ua tusa ai lea ma le faatulagaga ona ua tulai o ia i luga a’e o le lalolagi o loo e tu ai, o lea o le faitauga o lona taimi ua lē tele na’uā e pei o le aofai o ona aso, ma ona masina, ma ona tausaga.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: Now, Abraham, these two facts exist, behold thine eyes see it; it is given unto thee to know the times of reckoning, and the set time, yea, the set time of the earth upon which thou standest, and the set time of the greater light which is set to rule the day, and the set time of the lesser light which is set to rule the night.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: O lenei, Aperaamo e, o mea moni nei e lua o loo i ai, faauta ua vaai atu i ai ou mata; ua tuu atu ia te oe ia e iloa le faitauga o taimi, ma le taimi faatuina, ioe, le taimi faatuina o le lalolagi o loo e tulai ai, ma le taimi faatuina o le malamalama tele ua faatuina e pulea le ao, ma le taimi faatuina o le malamalama itiiti ua faatuina e pulea le po.

verses.en: Now the set time of the lesser light is a longer time as to its reckoning than the reckoning of the time of the earth upon which thou standest.
verses.sm: O lenei o le taimi faatuina o le malamalama itiiti e umi atu lona faitauga nai lo le faitauga o le taimi o le lalolagi o loo e tulai ai.

verses.en: And where these two facts exist, there shall be another fact above them, that is, there shall be another planet whose reckoning of time shall be longer still;
verses.sm: Ma i le mea e i ai ia mea moni e lua, e i ai se isi mea moni e i luga a’e o i laua, o lona uiga, e i ai se isi paneta e sili atu foi le umi o le faitauga o lona taimi.

verses.en: And thus there shall be the reckoning of the time of one planet above another, until thou come nigh unto Kolob, which Kolob is after the reckoning of the Lord’s time; which Kolob is set nigh unto the throne of God, to govern all those planets which belong to the same order as that upon which thou standest.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapena lava le faitauga o le taimi o le tasi paneta i luga a’e o le isi, seia oo lava ina e latalata atu ia Kolape, o Kolape lea ua tusa ma le faitauga o le taimi o le Alii; o Kolape lea ua faatuina latalata i le nofoalii o le Atua, e pulea paneta uma na e i ai i le faatulagaga e tasi e pei o lena o loo e tulai ai.

verses.en: And it is given unto thee to know the set time of all the stars that are set to give light, until thou come near unto the throne of God.
verses.sm: Ma ua tuuina atu ia te oe ia e iloa le taimi faatulagaina o fetu uma ua faatutu e tuu atu le malamalama, seia oo ina e oo latalata atu i le nofoalii o le Atua.

verses.en: Thus I, Abraham, talked with the Lord, face to face, as one man talketh with another; and he told me of the works which his hands had made;
verses.sm: Sa faapea ona talanoa a’u, o Aperaamo, ma le Alii, faafesagai lava, e pei ona talanoa se tasi tagata ma le isi; ma sa ta’u mai e ia ia te a’u e uiga i galuega na faia e ona aao;

verses.en: And he said unto me: My son, my son (and his hand was stretched out), behold I will show you all these. And he put his hand upon mine eyes, and I saw those things which his hands had made, which were many; and they multiplied before mine eyes, and I could not see the end thereof.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: Lo’u atalii e, lo’u atalii e, (ma sa faaloaloa mai lona aao), faauta o le a Ou faaali atu ia te oe nei mea uma. Ma sa tuu e ia lona aao i luga o o’u mata, ma sa ou vaai atu i na mea uma na faia e ona aao, o ni mea sa tele; ma sa faateleina i latou i luma o o’u mata, ma sa lē mafai ona ou vaai atu i so latou gataaga.

verses.en: And he said unto me: This is Shinehah, which is the sun. And he said unto me: Kokob, which is star. And he said unto me: Olea, which is the moon. And he said unto me: Kokaubeam, which signifies stars, or all the great lights, which were in the firmament of heaven.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: O Saianea lenei, o le la lea. Ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: O Kokapo, o se fetu. Ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: O Ole’a, o le masina lea. Ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: O Kokaupi, o lona uiga o fetu, po o malamalama tetele uma, sa i ai i le vanimonimo o le lagi.

verses.en: And it was in the night time when the Lord spake these words unto me: I will multiply thee, and thy seed after thee, like unto these; and if thou canst count the number of sands, so shall be the number of thy seeds.
verses.sm: Ma o le taimi o le po na fetalai mai ai e le Alii upu nei ia te a’u: O le a Ou faauluolaina oe, ma lau fanau e mulimuli mai pe a mavae atu oe, e pei o i latou nei; ma afai e mafai ona e faitauina le aofai o oneone, o le a faapea foi le aofai o au fanau.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: Abraham, I show these things unto thee before ye go into Egypt, that ye may declare all these words.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: Aperaamo e, Ou te faaali atu nei mea ia te oe ae e te lei alu atu i Aikupito, ina ia mafai ona e folafola atu ia upu uma.

verses.en: If two things exist, and there be one above the other, there shall be greater things above them; therefore Kolob is the greatest of all the Kokaubeam that thou hast seen, because it is nearest unto me.
verses.sm: Afai e i ai ni mea se lua, ma ua i ai le tasi i luga a’e o le isi, e i ai ni mea ua sili atu i luga a’e o i la’ua; o lea o Kolape o le silisili lea o Kokaupi uma na e vaai i ai, ona ua latalata tele mai o ia ia te a’u.

verses.en: Now, if there be two things, one above the other, and the moon be above the earth, then it may be that a planet or a star may exist above it; and there is nothing that the Lord thy God shall take in his heart to do but what he will do it.
verses.sm: O lenei, afai e i ai ni mea se lua, o le tasi i luga a’e o le isi, ma o le masina e i luga a’e i le lalolagi, ona atonu lea e i ai se paneta po o se fetu e i luga a’e o ia; ma e leai se mea e ave e le Alii lou Atua i lona loto e fai ae o le mea o le a faia e ia.

verses.en: Howbeit that he made the greater star; as, also, if there be two spirits, and one shall be more intelligent than the other, yet these two spirits, notwithstanding one is more intelligent than the other, have no beginning; they existed before, they shall have no end, they shall exist after, for they are gnolaum, or eternal.
verses.sm: Faapei ona faia e ia le fetu sili atu; e pei, foi, afai e i ai ni agaga se lua, ma ua sili atu le atamai o le tasi nai lo le isi, ae o ia agaga e lua, e ui ina sili atu le atamai o le tasi nai lo le isi, ua leai se amataga; sa i ai i laua muamua, o le a leai so laua gataaga, o le a i ai pea i laua pe a mavae le lalolagi, ona o i laua e nolama, pe faavavau.

verses.en: And the Lord said unto me: These two facts do exist, that there are two spirits, one being more intelligent than the other; there shall be another more intelligent than they; I am the Lord thy God, I am more intelligent than they all.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii ia te a’u: O mea moni nei e lua ua i ai, ua i ai ni agaga se lua, e sili atu le atamai o le tasi nai lo le isi; o le a i ai foi se isi e sili atu le atamai nai lo i laua; o A’u o le Alii lou Atua, ua sili atu lo’u atamai nai lo i latou uma.

verses.en: The Lord thy God sent his angel to deliver thee from the hands of the priest of Elkenah.
verses.sm: Sa auina atu e le Alii lou Atua lana agelu e laveai oe mai lima o le faitaulaga a Elekana.

verses.en: I dwell in the midst of them all; I now, therefore, have come down unto thee to declare unto thee the works which my hands have made, wherein my wisdom excelleth them all, for I rule in the heavens above, and in the earth beneath, in all wisdom and prudence, over all the intelligences thine eyes have seen from the beginning; I came down in the beginning in the midst of all the intelligences thou hast seen.
verses.sm: Ua Ou nofo i le lotolotoi o i latou uma; o lea, ua Ou sau nei i lalo ia te oe e ta’u atu ia te oe galuega na faia e o’u lima, lea e sili atu ai lo’u poto nai lo i latou uma, aua ua Ou pule i le lagi i lugā, ma le lalolagi i lalō, i le poto ma le faautauta atoa, i luga o atamai uma na vaai i ai ou mata mai le amataga; sa Ou alu ifo i le amataga i le lotolotoi o atamai uma na e vaai i ai.

verses.en: Now the Lord had shown unto me, Abraham, the intelligences that were organized before the world was; and among all these there were many of the noble and great ones;
verses.sm: O lenei sa faaali mai e le Alii ia te a’u, o Aperaamo, o atamai na faatulagaina ae lei i ai le lalolagi; ma i totonu o i latou uma ia sa i ai le toatele o e tamalii ma ta’uta’ua;

verses.en: And God saw these souls that they were good, and he stood in the midst of them, and he said: These I will make my rulers; for he stood among those that were spirits, and he saw that they were good; and he said unto me: Abraham, thou art one of them; thou wast chosen before thou wast born.
verses.sm: Ma sa silasila atu le Atua i ia agaga ua lelei i latou, ma sa tulai o ia i le lotolotoi o i latou, ma sa fetalai o ia: O i latou ia o le a Ou faia ma a’u pule; aua sa tulai o ia i le lotolotoi o i latou o ni agaga, ma sa silasila atu o ia ua lelei i latou; ma sa fetalai mai o ia ia te a’u: Aperaamo e, o oe o se tasi o i latou; sa filifilia oe ae e te lei fanau mai.

verses.en: And there stood one among them that was like unto God, and he said unto those who were with him: We will go down, for there is space there, and we will take of these materials, and we will make an earth whereon these may dwell;
verses.sm: Ma sa tulai mai se tasi i totonu o i latou sa pei o le Atua, ma sa fai atu o ia ia te i latou o e sa faatasi ma ia: O le a tatou o i lalō, ona o loo i ai se avanoa iina, ma o le a tatou ave mea nei, ma o le a tatou faia se lalolagi e nonofo ai i latou nei;

verses.en: And we will prove them herewith, to see if they will do all things whatsoever the Lord their God shall command them;
verses.sm: Ma o le a tatou tofotofoina ai i latou, e vaai pe latou te faia mea uma o soo se mea e poloaiina ai i latou e le Alii lo latou Atua;

verses.en: And they who keep their first estate shall be added upon; and they who keep not their first estate shall not have glory in the same kingdom with those who keep their first estate; and they who keep their second estate shall have glory added upon their heads for ever and ever.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou o e e tausia lo latou esetete muamua, o le a faaopoopoina i ai; ma o i latou o e e lē tausia lo latou esetete muamua o le a latou lē maua le mamalu i le malo e tasi faatasi ma i latou o e e tausia lo latou esetete muamua; ma o i latou o e e tausia lo latou esetete lona lua o le a faaopoopo i luga o o latou ulu le mamalu e faavavau ma faavavau lava.

verses.en: And the Lord said: Whom shall I send? And one answered like unto the Son of Man: Here am I, send me. And another answered and said: Here am I, send me. And the Lord said: I will send the first.
verses.sm: Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii: O ai Ou te auina atu? Ma sa tali mai se tasi e pei o le Atalii o le Tagata: O A’u lenei, auina atu a’u. Ma sa tali mai le isi ma fai mai: O a’u lenei, auina atu a’u. Ma sa fetalai mai le Alii: O le a Ou auina atu le muamua.

verses.en: And the second was angry, and kept not his first estate; and, at that day, many followed after him.
verses.sm: Ma sa ita le lona lua, ma sa lē tausia lona esetete muamua; ma, i lena aso, e toatele na mulimuli atu ia te ia.
